rfq_requirement: Quote OD tolerance and measurement method.
review_trigger: Cannot meet OD/tolerance forces spar fit and mass review.

rfq_requirement: Quote ID tolerance suitable for internal spigot fit.
review_trigger: ID/ovality too loose forces splice fit review.

rfq_requirement: Quote wall-thickness tolerance and minimum guaranteed wall.
review_trigger: Lower wall or high variation forces spar margin/mass review.

rfq_requirement: Quote actual mass per meter and batch variation.
review_trigger: Mass delta feeds mass/CG ledger review.

rfq_requirement: Quote OD tolerance and measurement method.
review_trigger: Cannot meet OD/tolerance forces rear-spar fit review.

rfq_requirement: Quote ID tolerance and sleeve-fit recommendation.
review_trigger: ID/ovality too loose forces rear-spar splice review.

rfq_requirement: Quote wall-thickness tolerance and minimum guaranteed wall.
review_trigger: Lower wall or high variation forces rear-spar review.

rfq_requirement: Quote actual mass per meter and batch variation.
review_trigger: Mass delta feeds mass/CG ledger review.

rfq_requirement: Confirm 3 m shipped/cut segment compatibility.
review_trigger: If 3 m cannot be shipped, procurement and transport concept need review.

rfq_requirement: Quote 12 full-wing main-spar segments plus optional spare allowance separately.
review_trigger: Different quantity basis requires station/length review.

rfq_requirement: Quote 12 full-wing rear-spar segments plus optional spare allowance separately.
review_trigger: Different quantity basis requires station/length review.

rfq_requirement: Confirm recommended spigot OD for 0.2 mm diametral clearance, or propose a tested alternative.
review_trigger: Fit change affects y=3 m zero-margin splice review.

rfq_requirement: Confirm bonded/slip-fit clearance for CFRP tube-in-tube joint.
review_trigger: Clearance change affects sleeve fit, ovality, and bondline review.

rfq_requirement: Confirm available wall and knockdowns for y=3 m inboard splice.
review_trigger: Any knockdown can make the zero-margin splice negative.

rfq_requirement: Confirm stock/custom spigot wall for outboard joints.
review_trigger: If unavailable, mass and fit review required.

rfq_requirement: Confirm 4D overlap each side is practical for bonding/inspection.
review_trigger: Overlap reduction forces splice redesign review.

rfq_requirement: Confirm ferrule ring manufacturability at 1.25 x main spar OD.
review_trigger: Ferrule geometry change affects torsion/shear-dog review.

rfq_requirement: Confirm ferrule width, edge prep, and bond process.
review_trigger: Width change affects torsion and local bearing review.

rfq_requirement: Confirm ferrule wall and local crush/bearing allowables.
review_trigger: Wall change affects mass and torsion review.

rfq_requirement: State straightness tolerance over each 3 m segment.
review_trigger: Poor straightness affects alignment, sleeve fit, and wing jigging.

rfq_requirement: State ovality tolerance before and after finish.
review_trigger: Poor ovality directly affects y=3 m sleeve margin.

rfq_requirement: State supplied surface finish and structural bond-prep compatibility.
review_trigger: Incompatible surface prep affects ferrules, spigots, and C04 saddle rings.

rfq_requirement: Provide certificate, batch traceability, and same-batch coupon/cutoff options.
review_trigger: No traceability/coupons limits procurement confidence.

rfq_requirement: State MOQ, lead time, custom mandrel cost, and replacement policy.
review_trigger: Commercial infeasibility may trigger procurement review.
